title: OneClient (Modpack / Client)
description: All in one modpack for OneClient by Polyfrost, the client for everyone. Optimized FPS / performance, world hosting, QoL features, in one place.
author: Wyvest

license.name: GNU General Public License v3.0 only

body:
# OneClient

OneClient ships the most bleeding-edge mods, packaged with the best visuals out of any client, powered by [OneConfig](https://modrinth.com/mod/oneconfig).

## Performance

In the background, our competitors like Lunar Client and Feather/Dawn Client literally **run an instance of Chromium _in-game_** to power their GUIs.

***Yes, clients actually are running Chrome IN YOUR _MINECRAFT_...***

We use our own rendering library called PolyCompose (based on JetBrains Compose), resulting in drastically better visuals but also performance.

We package almost **TWICE** as many performance mods as Fabulously Optimized (27 vs 14 mods), meaning performance is significantly better in-game. And don't even get us started with Lunar/Feather...

## User Interface

OneClient features a clean and sleek user interface, meticulously designed by actual designers. Optimized for looking good without sacrificing any easy of use. Supports themeing, so you can choose between what you prefer.

![OneClient UI](https://polyfrost.org/ui.webp)
![OneClient UI options](https://polyfrost.org/settings.webp)
![OneClient UI theming](https://polyfrost.org/themes.webp)

## HUDs

We package our own HUD mods: EvergreenHUD and VanillaHUD, two of the best HUD mods ever created for Minecraft. On [Hypixel SkyBlock](https://modrinth.com/modpack/oneclient-skyblock), we support all the major SkyBlock mod HUDs, meaning all your favorite mods' HUDs show in one place.

## Fully open-source

This should go without saying, but we are 100% open-source. We haven't had a single private repository on our GitHub since January 2026.
